title.en: A species name anchored to a cultured strain
title.zh: 以培养菌株为依据的物种名称

text.en: COL26.8 lists *Streptomyces shinuiensis* Lim et al., 2026 as an accepted species. The cited description centers on type strain HK10T, the reference culture used in naming the species. Its observations give a focused view of one strain and its laboratory characterization, rather than a survey of variation across the species.
text.zh: COL26.8 将 *Streptomyces shinuiensis* Lim et al., 2026 列为接受种名。所引物种描述以模式菌株 HK10T 为中心；模式菌株是用于命名该物种的参考培养菌株。相关观察呈现的是一个菌株及其培养特征，而非对整个物种内部差异的调查。

text.en: The species account describes HK10T as aerobic, Gram-stain-positive and filamentous. It reports branched substrate mycelium and aerial hyphae bearing spore chains. In culture on ISP2 medium, growth was reported from 25–40 °C, pH 7–9 and 0–9% NaCl, with optima of 30 °C, pH 8 and 3% NaCl. These are the reported culture conditions for the named strain, not environmental limits measured across wild populations.
text.zh: 物种描述将 HK10T 记为需氧、革兰氏染色阳性且呈丝状，并报告有分枝的基内菌丝，以及带孢子链的气生菌丝。研究报告称，该菌株在 ISP2 培养基上可于 25–40 °C、pH 7–9 和 0–9% NaCl 条件下生长；最适条件分别为 30 °C、pH 8 和 3% NaCl。这些数值是该菌株在所述培养条件下的结果，不是对野外种群环境耐受范围的测量。

title.en: A saltern sediment isolate and salternamides
title.zh: 盐田沉积物分离株与 salternamides

text.en: HK10T was isolated from saltern sediment on Shinui Island, Republic of Korea. The study identifies the strain as a producer of salternamides, drawing on the production context reported in earlier isolation work. This links the named cultured isolate to a particular collection setting and reported compound production; it does not establish the strain's ecological role in the saltern sediment.
text.zh: HK10T 分离自大韩民国新意岛的盐田沉积物。研究将该菌株识别为 salternamides 的产生菌，并以此前分离研究所报告的产物背景为依据。这把具名培养菌株与特定采样环境及所报告的化合物联系起来，但并未确定该菌株在盐田沉积物中的生态作用。

title.en: How the study distinguished the species
title.zh: 研究如何区分这一物种

text.en: The authors place HK10T within *Streptomyces* using 16S rRNA and phylogenomic evidence. They also report average nucleotide identity (ANI) and digital DNA–DNA hybridization (dDDH), two measures of genome similarity, below the species-delineation thresholds cited in their study for the comparator type strains. This is the authors' inference from that strain and comparison set; it is not a broader analysis of diversity within *Streptomyces*.
text.zh: 作者依据 16S rRNA 和系统基因组证据，将 HK10T 放入 *Streptomyces*。他们还报告了平均核苷酸一致性（ANI）和数字 DNA–DNA 杂交（dDDH）两种基因组相似性指标；相对于研究中比较的模式菌株，这些数值低于作者引用的物种划分阈值。这是作者基于该菌株和该比较集合提出的分类推断，并非对 *Streptomyces* 属内多样性的更广泛分析。

title.en: What does the type strain look like?

text.en: The published description centers on cultured type strain GH36T, the named reference strain in the study. Its cells were motile and irregularly granule-shaped, 1.0–4.0 micrometres (μm) across; the paper classifies them as Gram-negative by staining. Colonies were red, raised and round, about 0.5 mm wide. These observations are limited to GH36T under the reported conditions and do not establish variation across the species.
text.zh: 发表的物种描述以培养的型菌株 GH36T 为中心；型菌株是研究中用于界定该名称的参考菌株。其细胞可运动，呈不规则颗粒状，宽 1.0–4.0 μm（微米）；论文通过染色将其归为革兰氏阴性。菌落为红色、隆起、圆形，直径约 0.5 mm。这些观察仅适用于 GH36T 和所报告的条件，不能说明全种变异。

text.en: The type strain was isolated from a salt lake in China. This single reported source does not establish the species' wider distribution, abundance or ecological role.
text.zh: 型菌株采自中国的一处盐湖。这一处报告来源不能确定该物种的更广分布、丰度或生态作用。

title.en: How did the authors name the species?
title.zh: 研究者如何命名这个物种？

text.en: Genome-based comparisons and taxonomic characterization led the authors to propose Haloarcula montana for strain GH36T. That proposal is the authors' classification of the strain and does not establish variation across populations.
text.zh: 研究者依据基因组比较和分类鉴定，为菌株 GH36T 提出名称 Haloarcula montana。这是作者对该菌株作出的分类判断，不能据此说明不同种群间的变异。
